simulation_effects: LivingSim may calculate local workshop capacity, labor availability, safety strain, supply dependency, contract pressure and maintenance backlog.
Living Scale may expose only local chapter presences; each requires a political-unit or place reference and recorded consent.
UE5 imports may create faction and local-chapter data assets with authority, provenance, spoiler and permission fields.
story_generators: A repair guild becomes the only bridge between rival communities but must choose whom to serve first.
A disputed license turns an ordinary workshop into the center of a local investigation.
A crisis partnership solves an emergency while permanently changing who trusts whom in a town.
